name: A Shreveport lot

place_source.title: Wikidata: Shreveport (Q80517), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: A suburban lot in Shreveport: a mown lawn, a fenceline of American holly and sugarberry, a loblolly pine in the back corner, cardinals and mockingbirds by day and opossums, armadillos and a red fox after dark.

facts.text: Shreveport has a humid subtropical climate (Köppen Cfa): hot, humid summers and mild winters.

source.title: Wikipedia: Shreveport, Louisiana
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Shreveport, Louisiana", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: Summer highs exceed 90 °F (32 °C) on an average of 91 days a year, while winters are mild, with about 35 days of freezing temperatures.

source.title: Wikipedia: Shreveport, Louisiana
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Shreveport, Louisiana", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: Annual precipitation averages over 51 inches (1,300 mm), peaking in late spring and easing in late summer.

source.title: Wikipedia: Shreveport, Louisiana
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Shreveport, Louisiana", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: The bulk of Shreveport lies in Caddo Parish, along the west bank of the Red River, and the 2020 census counted 187,593 people in the city.

source.title: Wikipedia: Shreveport, Louisiana
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Shreveport, Louisiana", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: The city stands about 46 m above sea level.
